name: BeBetter Med Inc.
summary: BeBetter Med Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, and sale of drugs for oncology, metabolic diseases and central nervous system degenerative diseases. It offers BEBT-908, a PI3K/HDAC dual-target small molecule inhibitor for antitumor; developing BEBT-209, a CDK4/6 selective inhibitor for metastatic triple-negative breast cancer; and BEBT-109, a selective EGFR inhibitor designed for NSCLC.
